svg.title: Two 32-bit words: top-k entry mask and control
svg.desc: Both example tokens select six distinct experts on the same destination GPUs as the topology example: GPUs 8, 10, 13 and 15. Each top-k entry has its own color, repeated on its enabled mask bit. Relay and Direct masks are both 0x3f. The Direct control bit is zero for relay and one for Direct.
svg.text: Same top-k entries. Same destination GPUs. Two delivery modes.

g.text: The same top-k 6 routing table is used for both token examples (24 experts per GPU).
Bit j enables top-k entry j. The six colors identify entries, not GPU ranks.
Entries 0 and 5 share GPU 8; entries 1 and 4 share GPU 10. All stay enabled; copying deduplicates GPUs.
Word 1 (32 bits) · control · Direct bit + compact epoch label
27 reserved bits = 0; low five bits shown below
bit 4 = delivery mode · bits 3–0 = epoch label 1011
27 reserved bits = 0; low five bits shown below
bit 4 = delivery mode · bits 3–0 = epoch label 1011
32 entry bits support up to 32 routing entries without imposing a 32-GPU limit. The packet label is not readiness.

svg.text: Packet label 1011 · required full ready tag 59
The four-bit label wraps, but an old slot tagged 43 is not copied when the receiver requires 59.
Acquired completion, full-width tags and counters, and safe control cleanup establish readiness.
